target_value: T_w(deuteron) — word of length 12 on 6 strands
description: Frontier-paydown chain for the atomic-braid recipe specialised to deuteron (Z=1, N=1, include_inter=True).  Closes the last SCRIPT_CITED step in the deuteron atom chain.  Trust profile is {axiom: 3, derived: 1-2, computational: 0} — fully trusted modulo the brane-tower and nucleon-cross-table axioms (which are substrate-level specifications, not theorems to be proved).  Builder:  build_atomic_braid_recipe_chain.py.

steps.name: Categorical action B_6 → End(V^{⊗6})
steps.operation: The braid group B_6 acts on V^{⊗6} via the R-matrix on adjacent tensor factors (Drinfeld–Jimbo action of U_q(sl_2)).  Projection onto the Hecke quotient H_6(q) makes σ_i² = (q − q^{-1}) σ_i + 1.
steps.notes: Cat action axiom + Hecke energy axiom together specify the ambient algebra; no SCRIPT_CITED.

steps.name: Brane-tower convention: 3 strands per nucleon
steps.operation: Per the QOU brane-tower construction, each nucleon occupies 3 consecutive strands of the ambient braid: nucleon k uses strands (3k, 3k+1, 3k+2).  For A = 2, this gives n = 3·A = 6 strands total.
steps.notes: Substrate-level specification of nucleon = 3-strand braid; no Lean target yet (qou:STUB:).

steps.name: Per-nucleon intra-crossings (proton_cross / neutron_cross)
steps.operation: For each nucleon k of type t ∈ {p, n}, emit intra-crossings at generator indices (3k, 3k+1) per the substrate-level cross tables: proton has 6 intra-crossings (3 at each of σ_{3k}, σ_{3k+1}), neutron has 5 (asymmetric: 3 at σ_{3k}, 2 at σ_{3k+1}).  These cross tables are AXIOM-anchored at the substrate level — they specify the proton and neutron as distinct points of the brane tower, and are the simplest possible knot-type specifications consistent with B_3-action invariance.
steps.notes: Substrate-level definition of proton/neutron via their per-nucleon σ-words.  AXIOM rather than DERIVED because this IS the definition (no upstream principle yet derives the cross tables; they are the model's specification of what 'proton' and 'neutron' mean at the braid level).

steps.name: Inter-pair crossings (include_inter=True)
steps.operation:
For each adjacent nucleon pair (k, k+1) emit one inter-pair crossing at generator σ_{3k+2}; type depends on the pair:
  pp → σ (positive)
  nn → σ⁻¹ (negative)
  pn / np → averaged σ_avg = (σ + σ⁻¹)/2
For (Z, N) = (1, 1), this contributes 1 inter-pair generator(s).
steps.notes: Pure routing: pair classification → fixed σ-type per pair.  No new axiom; combinatorial application of the nucleon-type table from step 3.

steps.name: Assemble T_w(deuteron) σ-word
steps.operation: Concatenate the intra-crossings (step 3) and inter-pair crossings (step 4) in nucleon order to form T_w ∈ H_6(q).
steps.output_value: T_w(deuteron) ≡ (p-word at σ_0..σ_1) · σ_2(averaged) · (n-word at σ_3..σ_4); word length = 12
